race.comment: LONG LAUGH (1) did not cope with a heavy track here 17 days ago, and that effort is best forgotten. His form prior was very good with a pair of close-up second-place finishes, and he is overdue to pick up his first win, so stick with him. FARADIO (2) put in some good efforts as a 3YO, and won a trial easily prior to running on too late when resuming at Belmont 11 days ago. The extra 100m will suit him, and if he does not want more ground already, he is good enough to win this. DIAMOND CHOUX (6) did a good job last start when running on late after settling too far back from a wide draw. That changes here, and with a clever 3kg claim, she can finish a lot closer. Each way value. SPONGE CAKE (8) produced a disappointing run off a good run at Bunbury last time out. Her fresh-up effort is the guide to use, and with the blinkers on, she can bounce straight back into form. Include.
